command: git status --porcelain=v1 && echo "--- unbranch ---" && git branch --show-current && echo "--- stash ---" && git stash list
git status --short --ignored && echo "--- top level ---" && ls -la && echo "--- var ---" && ls -la var 2>/dev/null || true

cat .gitignore && echo "--- .env keys ---" && sed 's/=.*/=<redacted>/' .env && echo "--- gnomon-audit ---" && ls -la .gnomon-audit && echo "--- gnomon ---" && find .gnomon -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort && echo "--- var db type ---" && file var/local.db
head -c 800 var/local.db | sed 's/[A-Za-z0-9_\-]\{20,\}/<redacted>/g'; echo; echo "--- config ---"; cat .gnomon/config.toml
